Merlin Universal Air Bag

The Merlin Universal Airbag is a slip-on vest that works over any motorcycle jacket to provide Level 2 protection to your neck, spine and tailbone. The Airbag inflates in 80 millseconds when the CO2 canister is activated.

Features:

  • Suitable to fit over any motorcycle jacket
  • En1621/4 homologated level 2 motorcycle airbag
  • Mechanical inflation time of 80 milliseconds
  • Neck, spine and tailbone protection zones
  • 6.5 times more effective than a level 2 back protector
  • 15 liter total system volume
  • 800g approximate unit weight
  • Completely waterproof unit
  • Easy CO2 pressurized canister user recharge in the event of both accidental inflation or accident
  • 15kg activation weight trigger to prevent accidental inflation
  • 30 second full inflation duration before automatic pressure release
  • Cordura 500 outer with reflective elements
  • 4 year maintenance check for CE certification process
  • Includes airbag unit, pre-installed CO2 canister, activation cord with clip, seat strap, keyring reminder, serial registration information and user information
  • Made and tested in Italy

source_description_html:
The original Hixon jacket was first released in 2016 and was a staple of the Merlin collection for many years. As part of the Hixon refresh we have kept the well-received super soft and supple leather and added in a number of new improvements. The first of these upgrades includes D3O® armour which sits in the shoulders and elbows. Hixon II then has a revised fit with a slightly longer length, new design details and crucially includes more ventilation – with three back vents and two chest ventilation points added.

Materials

1.2-1.3mm Naked Cowhide Leather
Fixed Mesh Lining To Aid Breathability
Removable 100g Cross Quilted Thermal Lining
British Marton Mills® Tartan Liner Trim
Silver YKK® Zippers And Hardware

Protection

D3O® LP1 Shoulder And Elbow Protectors Pre-Fitted (CE Compliant To EN1621)
D3O® Viper Back Protector Pocket (CE Compliant To EN1621)
CE EN17092 AA

Pockets

Two Side Entry External Zipped Pockets With Leather Pull Tabs
Internal Fixed Liner Storage
Pockets On Removable Thermal Liner

Features

Two Front Ventilation Panels And Three Rear Vents
Cross Quilted Cuff, Shoulder And Hem
Centre Front Leather Zip Cover Tab
Snap Stud Hem Adjustment
Fold Back Collar For Warm Weather Riding
Subtle Merlin Branding
Short YKK® Jacket To Trouser Connecting Zip
Euro Jacket To Jean Connector Hoop
